test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which among the following states does NOT come under the catchment area of River Yamuna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Catchment Area:**

 
 
• A river drains the water collected from a specific area, which is called its catchment area.
 
 
 
• The **catchment area of the Yamuna river system covers parts of Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Delhi states.**
 
• Th**e tributaries contribute 70.9% of the catchment area** and the** balance of 29.1% accounted for direct drainage** into the Yamuna river or to the smaller tributaries.
 
• On the basis of Yamuna amounts to 40.2% of the Ganga Basin and 10.7% of the total land mass of the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Yamuna River:**

 
 
• The river Yamuna, a major tributary of the river Ganges, originates from the Yamunotri glacier near Banderpoonch peaks in the Mussourie range of the lower Himalayas at an elevation of about 6387 meters above mean sea level in district Uttarkashi.
 
• It is the l**argest tributary of the Ganga **in the northern Plains.
